Actual alpha transparency throughout background and between items, not checkerboard or white baked background.

assets.prompt: Create one realistic editorial photograph for an adult A1 English coursebook, landscape 4:3 composition. A bright welcoming independent second-hand clothing shop with full real background: orderly clothes racks, warm wood, daylight, rich but restrained natural colors. Exactly two original fictional adults around age 25, shown from head to knees or lower so clothing readable. LEFT: an East Asian woman Nia, short dark bob hair, wearing a plain green knee-length dress and a mustard yellow brimmed hat, carrying a small brown shoulder bag. She holds and reads an unfolded cream paper leaflet at chest height, with no readable lettering, looking down at its page. RIGHT: a Black man Eli with short curly hair, wearing a clearly blue denim jacket over a white T-shirt and dark jeans. He looks down at the blue jacket he is currently wearing, one hand touching its lapel, naturally talking to Nia. Nobody holds another jacket. Both relaxed, expressive, natural anatomy and everyday adult proportions, attractive professional textbook photography without fashion-ad gloss. Keep the main characters large and legible, uncluttered background supporting second-hand shop. No labels, text, logos, caption, frame or page design. This scene is fictional, not a depiction of Vince Lombardi or the real thrift-shop find.

assets.prompt: Create one high quality realistic textbook editorial photo, landscape ratio about 2:1, full natural background of a sunny town park with a bench and soft leafy depth. Exactly THREE clearly separated original fictional adults, full body, large enough to inspect their outfits, comfortable everyday proportions. LEFT: woman with curly dark hair, standing and reading an open book; wearing a RED knitted sweater, dark BLUE jeans and WHITE shoes, no hat, no bag. MIDDLE: man with straight dark hair sitting on the bench, drinking from a plain white cup; wearing a WHITE short-sleeved T-shirt, black jeans, white shoes and a YELLOW brimmed hat, no jacket. RIGHT: woman with long brown hair standing and talking on a mobile phone; wearing a GREEN sleeveless knee-length dress, white shoes and carrying a BROWN shoulder bag, no hat. Strict distinction: left reads, middle drinks, right talks on phone. No additional people or clothing props. Clear readable gestures, faces, hands, no hand deformities, natural relaxed human moment, cheerful saturated colors and full photographic scene. Leave small natural gaps separating each person; do not collage. No words, letters, numbers, signs, logos or graphic design. Exact outfits and actions are educational evidence.
